reviews.text: I cannot speak highly enough about Dr. Vanama and the team at Pets and Vets Animal Hospital. Our dog has been patient of Dr Vanama for 6 years. We are always greeted with warmth and genuine concern for our furry baby's well-being. Dr. Vanama is incredibly knowledgeable and took the time to explain every step of the treatment process, making sure we felt comfortable and informed.

Dr. Vanama and her staff are highly educated, attentive, caring, and professional. I have personally taken my cats and dogs to her facility for over 5 years now and have never been dissatisfied and I have felt that my animals were always getting the care they deserved.

We recently got a Corgi puppy and have been bringing her here for the past couple of months. Dr. Vanama and Katie are both so nice and knowledgeable about what our pup needs to live a healthy life. We really appreciated all the info about what food/treats and toys are best. We can’t recommend them highly enough

ai_posts.content: 🦷✨ **Pet Dental Health Matters!** 🐾 Regular dental care is essential for your pet's well-being. Daily brushing and annual professional cleanings can prevent painful dental disease and maintain that beautiful smile. Talk to your vet about the best dental care routine for your furry companion! 🐶💖

team_members.name: Dr Priya Vanama
team_members.title: Owner & Chief Veterinarian
team_members.bio: Dr. Vanama is a skilled veterinarian committed to delivering high-quality medical care, preventive health, and advanced treatments for pets. With professional expertise and compassion, Dr. Vanama ensures the well-being of every animal entrusted to their care

team_members.name: Katie
team_members.title: Manager & Veterinary Technician
team_members.bio: Katie is a caring veterinary technician who treats every pet as if they were her own, providing gentle care and dedicated support to keep them healthy and happy.

ai_agents.post_content:
Fast Relief When You Need It Most
When your pet needs care—not just quickly, but right away—our Urgent Veterinary Services deliver fast, compassionate relief when your regular vet is closed or unavailable. At Pets and Vets Animal Hospital, we treat your family pets with the expertise and empathy they deserve.
